pickup.activation: Complete same-source A3 re-adjudication: all three B main gates formally fail

capture_design.count_source: positive-demand customers in sealed training dataset
capture_design.scope: offline teacher sampling only; no future cardinality passed to actor

pickup.primary_criterion: mean>=20 and day-cluster bootstrap ci_lo>0; both hard=1; 40 unique days and complete source/data/contract/weight identity
pickup.attribution_criterion: I3-minus-reconstruction-control mean>0 and day-cluster ci_lo>0; secondary, never replaces primary gate
pickup.iteration: Separate same-weight equal-K/10s protocol after single-step primary success; this study establishes no iteration gain
pickup.teacher_scope: Fixed cond_hist continuation under infinite decision time, not an optimal oracle or deployment-10s trajectory
pickup.hypothesis: Decision-aware risk learning can improve sampled accept/reject margins beyond reconstruction-only training; not triggered by a claimed predictive NLL improvement
pickup.limits: Warmstart has seen all 200 history days; heldout teacher objectives do not prove unseen-day generalization. Actor input is visible order tokens and clock only, not fleet/resources.
pickup.failure_policy: Keep all states/days/timeouts and attempts. No parameter/checkpoint changes from online results. Next mechanism requires a new protocol.

sampling_amendment.reason: Fixed ordinal 174 does not exist on days 12/25/29; capped variable arrival data supports 125 of 128 old captures
sampling_amendment.scientific_change: offline state sampling positions only; training/online/gates unchanged
sampling_amendment.human_approval: 批准修订并整轮重采（推荐）

delivery.authorization: User requested independent delivery contract/baselines, same-initial-route equal-budget pilot, positive-clue-only online full validation
delivery.activation: Delivery contract and baseline engineering QA plus actual pretrained encoder/decoder and same-architecture random control QA pass; freeze full runner closure before creating development instances
delivery.parameter_scope: pilot physics references, not calibrated operational evidence

dataset.origin: new synthetic delivery-only instances; no pickup teacher or results reused
dataset.independent_unit: one newly generated route snapshot per instance_id, no repeated solver runs counted as new instances
dataset.generator: numpy PCG64 SeedSequence([seed,instance_id]); customer coords uniform [0,10]^2 km; depot [5,5]; integer demands uniform 1..5; temp_class uniform 0..2
dataset.time_window_scope: broad windows in first route-transfer pilot; does not establish performance under tight TW or dynamic release
dataset.same_initial_routes: five fixed customer-ID blocks [1..10],[11..20],[21..30],[31..40],[41..50], same order; independently certify all 32 before running any improvement arm
dataset.final_holdout: not generated or accessed by this pilot; online development/final sets require a separate declaration

weights.use: full original CVRP encoder and decoder; no I3 actor; no adaptation training

excluded_common_setup: fixed synthetic 51-node JIT prewarm of both actual and random models
timing.hardware: same pinned CPU54, BLAS and OMP one thread, no GPU allocation
timing.method_uses_less_than_limit: report actual wall time; unused budget is not credited as additional gain
timing.late_submission: common initial certified route fallback, count timeout; do not drop instance
timing.arm_order: fixed numpy SeedSequence([seed,instance_id,999]) permutation of five improvement arms, recorded per instance

reconstruction.mask: uniform customer subset ceil(0.3*N); only original nonremoved edges retained, no shortcut edges as model observations
reconstruction.retained_edges: cannot be removed by insertion within a reconstruction cycle
reconstruction.insertion_score: distance_delta / instance mean offdiagonal distance - guide_weight * logit_delta / offdiagonal logit std
reconstruction.single: one masked decode-reconstruct candidate; choose common incumbent or lower full contract cost
reconstruction.iterative: same weights and score; repeatedly remask current best while total deadline allows; no training difference
reconstruction.seed: SeedSequence([dataset.seed,instance_id,41]); same mask stream in pretrained single/iteration and random single

baseline.ortools: same initial assignment, distance GLS proposals with capacity/TW dimensions; independently certify and select by full cold-chain contract objective
baseline.lns: same initial routes, random customer removal max(2,N//5), regret-2 distance insertion, annealed current route, full cold-chain certified best
baseline.scope: two runnable classical search candidates; neither called validated online SOTA or HGS/ALNS

delivery.main_metric: fractional cost gain (control_cost - method_cost) / control_cost; lower full contract cost is better
delivery.pilot_pass: maskco_single mean fractional gain >=1% and CI lower>0 against EACH of OR-Tools and regret-LNS; also positive mean and CI lower>0 against same-architecture random single; all six arms hard=1, exactly 32 unique finite paired instances, full source/contract/data/weight/timing identity and source_start=source_end
delivery.failure_branch: retain all instances/attempts and diagnose; no threshold/weight/budget/checkpoint/instance/seed adjustment or automatic rerun for better means; no delivery online full run
delivery.success_branch: qualified route-transfer clue only; separately preregister and implement real delivery wave/fleet/cargo online contract and strong rolling controls before online full validation

parameter_evidence_boundary: 192 steps, K10, 10s/4s, sample size, tau20, cap100, gap5, delta20 and bootstrap2000 are registered engineering/statistical choices, not values proven optimal by cited papers. D physical parameters retain previous 16-group provenance/calibration barriers.
